culprit_citations.quoted_text: Debt (net of unamortized debt issuance costs) | 1,152,791,515

rationale: Raw filing anchors contradict the flagged 0.3362 divergence. Fund leverage from debt divided by net assets is 1,152,791,515 / 1,332,667,798 = 0.8650. The schedule holdings debt share is (2,247,861,274 first lien plus 17,193,750 unsecured) / 2,487,588,823 total portfolio = 0.9105, a divergence of only 0.0455, within the 0.20 threshold. The reported holdings proxy therefore omits or misclassifies debt exposure; the aggregate source structure localizes the defect to holdings-side classification, but not to a single position.
